front text: samudra vasanē dēvī parvata stana maṇḍalē
āyurbalaṃ yaśo varcaḥ prajāḥ paśuvasūni ca
brahamaprajñaṃ ca medhāṃ ca tvaṃ no dehi vanaspate
gaṇge ca yamune caiva godāvari sarasvati
kāveri narmade sindho jale'smin sannidhiṃ kuru
apavitraḥ pavitro vā sarvāvasthāṃ gato'pi vā
gurussākṣāt paraṃ brahma tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ
yaḥ śivo nāmarūpābhyaṃ yā devī sarvamaṅgalā
rakṣa rakṣa mahābāho śāstre tabhyaṃ namo namaḥ
namaḥ sūryāya candrāya maṅgalāya budhāya ca
